name: Umi ni Ochite...
source:
Hero is sailing on his yacht when he finds a small plane crashed in the sea. Inside he finds a dead old man and a young girl who he brings home. Hero decides to sail the girl home to Hawaii and they start the voyage through the ocean.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-november-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角驾驶游艇出海时，发现了一架坠入海中的小型飞机。机内有一名已经死去的老人和一名年轻女孩，他将女孩带回了家。主角决定驾船送她返回夏威夷，两人就此开始了横渡大洋的旅程。

（来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-november-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]）
